create_FrankaArm: create a FrankaArm instance to connect to a Franka robot at a given IP address
run_FrankaArm_connect: run the FrankaArm connect method to establish a hardware connection with a PD policy
test_FrankaArm_apply_commands: test the FrankaArm apply_commands method to send desired joint positions to the robot
review_JointPDPolicy: review the JointPDPolicy class that performs PD control around a desired joint position
summarize_get_args: summarize the get_args function that parses command-line arguments for the server IP address
